example.title: Apartment building no. 1044 over tuck-under garages
example.place: Santa Monica, Los Angeles County, CA

brief: An early-1970s three-storey apartment block: beige stucco with panels of pebbled aggregate between the windows, recessed balconies, four blue garage doors along the ground floor. One photo. Scaled to the lot. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
